verdict.rationale: Reducto publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec on its docs site (openapi.json returns 200), its llms.txt index links an API section, and the docs include copy-paste code examples such as `client.parse.run(...)` against a hosted sample PDF. That is the raw material for an API reference with runnable examples, but nothing in the pack shows an interactive "try it" playground inside the reference. Studio lets users test workflows on real documents, but it is a workflow builder rather than an API reference. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer or playground, and runnable examples embedded in the reference pages themselves.
